name: mirage
text: No release is building yet, and nothing is released. The bet slip fix is built and compiles. The CH31 features (paper-record cards, Paper/Real stakes, BoltOdds and SX scores) are written down but I haven't started the code. This session spent its time answering you. I'm starting on them now, beginning with the Live-board cards, and I'll ship one release with the slip fix and the features when the test suite passes. I'll message you with the link. If you need the slip fix sooner, say so and I'll release it alone.
